notes.title: New map: Old industry
notes.content:
[h1]Discover "Old industry", the sensational new map added to Aster FPV.[/h1]

[h2]An Industrial World to Explore:[/h2] Dive into the heart of old industry reimagined for fpv, offering unique urban settings and captivating industrial environments. Explore abandoned structures and striking industrial landscapes for an immersive flying experience.

[h2]Challenge your Limits:[/h2] Test your piloting skills in this innovative setting. Face new challenges, navigate complex obstacles and push your limits in this breathtaking new Map where every nook and cranny is full of surprises and new challenges to sharpen your piloting skills.

[h2]Available now:[/h2] This brand-new map is available today for all FPV drone enthusiasts. Immerse yourself in this immersive experience and explore this unique industrial landscape!

Don't miss the opportunity to discover this captivating new map in the Aster FPV universe. Get ready for an unparalleled flying experience in this revisited industrial setting!

notes.title: Bug fixes related to the last update
notes.content:
Bug fixes related to the last update
* A Bloom effect in the Controller menu made it impossible to calibrate the controller
* After loading a map it was possible to have a white screen
* On Mac, Bloom and occlusion effects will be activated soon

notes.title: Fixed a performance bug since the integration of missions
notes.content: Fixed a performance bug particularly visible during the dive mission on the Sun map. If the frame rate is abnormally low since the integration of the missions, the update 21.10.28 should correct this problem.
